additional_info.subject: ID0394359-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N9 160381803] Touchscreen issue CRM:00641000867
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
hhva
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N9 160381803
Charger ID/Serial No.:
jZrCsy
Problem Description: Touchscreen issue
Actions to Perform On-Site:
To ensure optimal functionality and resolve potential issues, verify all connections between KF1 and PH2 to eliminate loose connections, and check the integrity of DPP and USB connections for OC display and touchscreen functionality.
Measure the supply voltage to ensure a stable 24V output and test the DPP and USB cables by swapping them with known working ones to rule out cable faults. Confirm that the D-Logic controller is updated with the latest firmware.
Inspect the electrical wiring thoroughly, ensuring FC-12 in the automation area hasn’t tripped, and examine all wiring related to the HMI and D-Logic controller for any potential problems.
Finally, during updates or interventions, ensure the PCB is securely connected and handle the flat ribbon cable with care to prevent damage.
Please ensure the spare parts HMI, DPP and USB cable are available during the visit for replacement, if necessary
For guidance, refer to the attached HMI schematic with marked components and additionally refer KA if all the schematic has been checked from your side.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Screen Upside Down_HMI Touch Repsonse - Dynamics 365
When ordering spare parts, please consider the type of existing control panel to ensure compatibility with the new HMI.
For your reference, kindly review the parts listed below.
If you require any further assistance or clarification, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [09/01/2024], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
